ei.title: How Smartphones Reshaped Gen Z's Social Life
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Gen Z became the first generation in history to go through puberty with a portal in their pockets that called them away from the people nearby and into an alternative universe that was exciting, addictive, unstable, and unsuitable for children and adolescents. Succeeding socially in that universe required them to devote a large part of their consciousness — perpetually — to managing what became their online brand. This was now necessary to gain acceptance from peers, which is the oxygen of adolescence, and to avoid online shaming, which is the nightmare of adolescence. Gen Z teens got sucked into spending many hours of each day scrolling through the shiny happy posts of friends, acquaintances, and distant influencers. They watched increasing quantities of user-generated videos and streamed entertainment, offered to them by autoplay and algorithms that were designed to keep them online as long as possible. They spent far less time playing with, talking to, touching, or even making eye contact with their friends and families, thereby reducing their participation in embodied social behaviors that are essential for successful human development.

This was now necessary to gain (C)[acceptance / rejection] from peers, which is the oxygen of adolescence, and to avoid online shaming, which is the nightmare of adolescence. They watched increasing quantities of user-generated videos and streamed entertainment, offered to them by autoplay and algorithms that were designed to keep them online as long as possible. They spent far less time playing with, talking to, touching, or even making eye contact with their friends and families, thereby reducing their participation in embodied social behaviors that are essential for successful human development.

det.analysis: thereby 뒤에 현재분사형이 와서 결과를 나타내는 분사구문 구성. reduce → reducing

questions.passage: Gen Z became the first generation in history to go through puberty with a portal in their pockets that called them away from the people nearby and into an alternative universe that was exciting, addictive, unstable, and unsuitable for children and adolescents. Succeeding socially in that universe required them to devote a large part of their consciousness — perpetually — to managing what became their online brand. This was now necessary to gain acceptance from peers, which is the oxygen of adolescence, and to avoid online shaming, which is the nightmare of adolescence. Gen Z teens got sucked into spending many hours of each day scrolling through the shiny happy posts of friends, acquaintances, and distant influencers. They watched increasing quantities of user-generated videos and streamed entertainment, offered to them by autoplay and algorithms that were designed to keep them online __________. They spent far less time playing with, talking to, touching, or even making eye contact with their friends and families, thereby reducing their participation in embodied social behaviors that are essential for successful human development.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가능한 한 오래 온라인에 있게 설계된 알고리즘이라는 맥락
det.analysis:
① as long as possible: 가능한 한 오래 — 알고리즘이 온라인에 ____ 있게 설계됐다는 맥락에 정합 ←정답
② away from the people nearby: 사람들로부터 멀리 — 다른 문장 표현
③ far less time: 훨씬 적은 시간 — 다른 문장 표현
④ as soon as possible: 가능한 한 빨리 — 오래 있게 하는 맥락과 의미 상이
det.tip: as long as possible=가능한 한 오래

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 체화된 사회적 행동 참여를 줄였다는 맥락
det.analysis:
① through the shiny happy posts: 빛나는 행복한 게시물을 통해 — 다른 문장 표현
② in embodied social behaviors: 체화된 사회적 행동에서 — thereby reducing their participation ____와 결합하여 정합 ←정답
③ into an alternative universe: 대안적 우주로 — 다른 문장 표현
④ away from the people nearby: 근처 사람들로부터 멀어져 — 다른 문장 표현
